name: Zaphiel
source:
[spoiler]Elder brother of [url=https://vndb.org/c170845]Ansh[/url].
[/spoiler]
"A devout apostle harboring the blessing of an angel.

With lighthearted words, he shines a guiding light upon others—
and in the depths where that light cannot reach, he prays in silence."

(Description translated from [url=https://putrika.totometori.com/2ndcut#character]Official website[/url])
